title: Dignity and residents
request: A diverse group of residents at eye level, avoiding claims that photographed people receive benefits.

title: Tax-funded services
request: Photographic montage of healthcare, school, childcare, library and sport; verified identities.

title: Accessible services
request: An actual public library reading room, illustrative of source low-cost services, no invented prices.

title: Support in difficult circumstances
request: Original pictorial diagram showing illness, unemployment and financial support without fixed amounts.

title: Service funding
request: Schematic tax-funding arrow into public healthcare and education, no numerical tax claims.

title: Taxation comparison
request: Tax receipt and public-services icons; no fabricated country comparison statistics.

title: Individuals and companies
request: Distinct visible individual worker and company office connected to taxes.

title: Attitudes to taxes
request: Research document and public-service illustration; no invented poll percentages.

title: Public debate
request: Actual Finnish parliamentary plenary chamber photograph, illustrative, not a particular vote.

title: Funding choices
request: Original balance between service provision and tax funding, no implied correct tax rate.

title: Political opinions
request: Distinct party discussion/separate speech bubbles representing differing opinions, no party endorsement.

title: Free discussion
request: Licensed community public-discussion photograph with accurate context.

title: Benefit recipients

title: Housing support
request: Photograph of accurately identified Finnish residential housing; no statement that residents receive benefits.

title: FPA card

request: Licensed actual Finnish pharmacy exterior/interior photograph, not an assertion that particular items are covered.

title: Own contribution

title: Benefits and law

title: Application examination

title: Working in Finland
request: Licensed photograph of an actual Finnish workplace, no asserted personal entitlement.

title: Possible residence situations
request: Schematic introductory checklist to the following source situations, without independent new conditions.

title: Return migration

title: Permanent employment

title: Residence permit validity

title: Home-country social security

title: EU insurance periods

title: International affairs centre
request: Licensed photograph of actual FPA premises/contact service or source-based contact illustration without fabricated phone numbers.
